# Knowledge map: Storage, SD card and backup service

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/storage-sd-backup.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Storage tables, ring-buffer write pipeline, backup service and presets, SD/SDHCI/ADMA2 stack, mmca/ms character devices and SD recovery.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-24.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 21 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Frontier

### <a id="f01"></a>F01 - Zero-scratch read-only DCIM/100MSDCF USTAR streaming from /dev/mmca1

- **State:** `not-started`
- **Next:** Extend card_read.c's read-only FAT32/exFAT parser (/dev/mmca1 250:11) with 2-level DCIM/100MSDCF lookup and stream 16 KiB-page-aligned POSIX ustar headers + ARW clusters over a backpressured socket with 0 B written to /tmp_bt or SD.
- **Evidence:** [E0056](../evidence/0056-sd-card-inputs-and-update-surface.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md)

## Hazards (read before any camera run)

| ID | Hazard | Effect | Rule | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="h01"></a>H01 | Persisted settings written from RAM | Forced Backup.bin values (1080p NVRAM patch) survived power cycles and stalled the cold boot. | Treat /setting/Backup.* as persistent: RAM patches to backed-up tables are saved on power-off. Never write it without explicit scope. | [E0138](../evidence/0138-emergency-sd-reset-card-recovery.md), [E0137](../evidence/0137-liveview-1080p-patch-and-ptp-cinema-monitor-contract.md) |
| <a id="h02"></a>H02 | Physical SD card is an input, not a scratch disk | SD changes can corrupt camera state or lose captures. | Physical SD (E:) is read-only for emulator inputs; diagnostic writes stay under /tmp_bt unless explicitly authorized. | [E0056](../evidence/0056-sd-card-inputs-and-update-surface.md), [E0219](../evidence/0219-sd-journal-authorization-and-storage-preflight.md) |

## Entities

### <a id="proc-storage-ringbuffer"></a>Storage tables and RingBuffer write pipeline

`proc.storage-ringbuffer` | process

Updater/storage tables, the ring-buffer dispatcher and the producer pipeline down to physical storage writes, with an emulator write guard.

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` Storage-table consumers, the updater partition-image copy/write path, ring-buffer dispatch and the RingBuffer producer pipeline down to the physical storage write were traced; emulated writes stop at a storage write guard. ([E0009](../evidence/0009-storage-driver-consumers.md), [E0011](../evidence/0011-updater-image-write-path.md), [E0012](../evidence/0012-ring-buffer-and-storage-write.md), [E0013](../evidence/0013-producer-and-physical-storage-trace.md))
- **C02** `OFFLINE` Boot mount selection, device-node resolution and runtime mount state were recovered; unsupplied runtime mounts stay unknown. ([E0008](../evidence/0008-runtime-mount-boundaries.md), [E0014](../evidence/0014-boot-selection-and-root-device.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` The original compressed-header comparison was reproduced on the extracted images. ([E0010](../evidence/0010-compressed-header-comparison.md))

### <a id="proc-backup"></a>Backup service and presets

`proc.backup` | process | inventory `kernel.modules:backup`

Sony backup service (backup.ko + user dispatch) that reads/writes presets and settings; saved to /setting/Backup.* on power-off.

Aliases: `Backup.bin`, `/setting/Backup`

Current knowledge:

- **C03** `OFFLINE` The backup service is guarded with a bounded LIRO entry; original backup dispatch, packaged preset lookups, boot parameters, kernel address conversion and the write pipeline run, and preset-backed RAM mutations are verified. ([E0029](../evidence/0029-backup-service-guard-and-liro-entry.md), [E0030](../evidence/0030-rea-backup-dispatch-and-preset-state.md), [E0031](../evidence/0031-backup-boot-parameters-and-ram-mapping.md), [E0032](../evidence/0032-preset-backed-backup-service-and-liro-module-parameters.md))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` Backup_read_multi and the WBI /dev/stream log area at 0x20030000 lead to /dev/mmca-char; the mmca-char and ms-char driver contracts are modelled. ([E0078](../evidence/0078-backup-read-multi-wbi-stream-log-and-mmca-char-boundary.md), [E0079](../evidence/0079-mmca-char-ms-char-contracts-and-102m-urandom-fstat64-boundary.md))
- **C06** `PHYSICAL` A cold boot with a forced 1080p NVRAM/Backup.bin configuration stalled recording and USB; recovery used an emergency SD card reset procedure. ([E0138](../evidence/0138-emergency-sd-reset-card-recovery.md))

### <a id="dev-sd-stack"></a>SD stack (mmc_drv, SDHCI, ADMA2)

`dev.sd-stack` | device | inventory `kernel.modules:mmc_drv`, `kernel.modules:ms_drv`

SD communication layers, the registered read ioctl, the serialized transfer pipeline, SDHCI host context and ADMA2 scatter-gather DMA, and the mmca/ms character devices.

Aliases: `/dev/mmca-char`, `/dev/ms-char`, `A: drive`

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `OFFLINE` SD layers, original read bounds, the registered read ioctl, serialized transfer pipeline, SDHCI host context with recursive mutexes and ADMA2 scatter-gather DMA execute down to SD sector requests. ([E0056](../evidence/0056-sd-card-inputs-and-update-surface.md), [E0057](../evidence/0057-sd-communication-layers-and-original-read-bounds.md), [E0058](../evidence/0058-sd-read-ioctl-and-preparation-state.md), [E0059](../evidence/0059-sd-serialized-transfer-and-card-reference-init.md), [E0060](../evidence/0060-sd-host-hardware-contract-and-recursive-lock.md), [E0061](../evidence/0061-sd-dma-scatter-gather-and-adma2-contract.md), [E0062](../evidence/0062-sdhci-adma2-bridge-and-physical-volume-read.md))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` Backup_read_multi and the WBI /dev/stream log area at 0x20030000 lead to /dev/mmca-char; the mmca-char and ms-char driver contracts are modelled. ([E0078](../evidence/0078-backup-read-multi-wbi-stream-log-and-mmca-char-boundary.md), [E0079](../evidence/0079-mmca-char-ms-char-contracts-and-102m-urandom-fstat64-boundary.md))
